text: どの　ポケモンに　おしえさせて　みるか？

structure.jp: おしえさせて　みるか？
structure.en: shall we try having it learn?

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means making or letting someone do the action; the game uses it loosely here for getting the move taught. おしえさせて = 'have it taught'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: おしえさせて　みる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form means doing something to see how it goes. おしえさせて　みる = 'try having it taught'.

patterns.name: 〜か (question)
patterns.explanation: か at the end turns the sentence into a question; straight after a plain verb it sounds blunt and manly. みるか = 'shall we try?'
